nodes.name: GitHub list open issues
nodes.notes: H8562 v3: consistent REST list, never lagged search. alwaysOutputData — empty array still emits one item, so the FIRST issue on an empty board is created; supported pagination (page=$pageCount+1, empty-page complete, max 20). Rationale: docs/ops/SOFT_ALERT_WEBHOOK.md §4.

nodes.name: GitHub comment on existing
nodes.notes: A repeat delivery comments on the lowest-numbered open issue whose body PROVES the same full fingerprint.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ title: $('Match exact title').first().json.expected_title, body: $('Match exact title').first().json.issue_body, labels: ['ops-soft-alert'], assignees: ['pe4kinsmart-tech'] }) }}

nodes.name: GitHub create issue
nodes.notes: Reachable ONLY from the IF-existing false branch. H8562 v3: reads expected_title from the Match node; the body carries the full-fingerprint marker (the dedup key — do not drop); failed-unit detection stays.

nodes.name: GitHub reconcile list
nodes.notes: H8562 v3 post-create reconcile: the higher-numbered creator always sees the lower-numbered rival (serial numbers + consistent list) and closes exactly itself; rivals require the FULL fingerprint, so an 8-hex collision is never a rival. Rationale: docs/ops/SOFT_ALERT_WEBHOOK.md §4.

parameters.notes: Lowest-number-wins: close self only when an open issue with the exact title AND full fingerprint has a LOWER number. Live-fix 27-11-2026: number/larger/value2 comparison (a boolean condition without value2 evaluated true on BOTH branches in real n8n - execution 17395).

nodes.name: IF we are the duplicate
nodes.notes: Lowest-number-wins: close self only when an open issue with the exact title AND full fingerprint has a LOWER number.

nodes.name: GitHub close duplicate
nodes.notes: Closes exactly OUR own just-created issue — the URL pins the create node's number, never a rival's.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "ok": true, "converged": true, "issue": $('GitHub create issue').first().json.html_url || null, "converged_into": $('Reconcile find rival').first().json.rival.html_url || null } }}

nodes.name: Sweep schedule
nodes.notes: H8562 v3 sweep every 6 h. Closes ONLY duplicates whose bodies prove the same full fingerprint; the storm backlog qualifies if its bodies carry the legacy line (rollout contract step 1). Unprovable issues stay open for a human.

nodes.name: Sweep list open issues
nodes.notes: Same consistent list + alwaysOutputData + supported pagination as the webhook flow: the whole open backlog is visible to the sweep, not just the 100 newest. Rationale: docs/ops/SOFT_ALERT_WEBHOOK.md §4.

nodes.name: Sweep close duplicate
nodes.notes: Per-item (n8n). Closes ONLY non-minimal duplicates; the survivor is never closed.

parameters.jsonBody: {"body":"Closed as duplicate - periodic soft-alert dedup sweep (H8562). Survivor: the lowest-numbered OPEN issue with the same title and full fingerprint."}

nodes.name: Sweep comment duplicate
nodes.notes: $json is the PATCH response, so $json.number IS the duplicate.
